notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Significant In-Game Changes:

    - Katie's storyline added.


Bug Fixes:

    - Lean Q-E function removed due to lack of functionality.
    - Fail screen menu load time reduced to 2 seconds.
    - Tab key no longer allows typing in the text field.
    - Fail animation corrected.
